purpose: Compare the old signal model with trade_plan_v2 and the walk-forward family gate using only information available before each signal.

assumptions.sharedSignals: The comparison isolates exit/risk/gating effects by replaying the same historical signal events.
unavailable: Actual account fee tier, fills, funding payments and liquidation state
Historical 50m USDT universe filter for every signal
assumptions.oldPortfolioStopProxy: Fixed-8h old trades use a 3% stop proxy only for account-risk sizing.
assumptions.sameCandleCollision: Conservative: stop is counted before target.
assumptions.noLookAheadGate: The family gate uses only paper trades whose exitTime is earlier than the next signal entryTime.
